
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Zeeh-Lin/p/19145313" title="发布于 2025-10-16 12:23">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">auipc指令在NEMU中的执行过程</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        auipc指令在NEMU中的执行过程
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="假设">假设</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>指令集为RV64I</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>内存地址开始于<code>0x8000 0000</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>使用如下的代码：</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">static const uint32_t img [] = {
    0x00000297,  // auipc t0,0
    0x00028823,  // sb  zero,16(t0)
    0x0102c503,  // lbu a0,16(t0)
    0x00100073,  // ebreak (used as nemu_trap)
    0xdeadbeef,  // some data
};
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>Decode</code>的定义如下</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">typedef struct Decode {
    uint64_t pc;
    uint64_t snpc; // static next pc
    uint64_t dnpc; // dynamic next pc
    struct {
        uint32_t inst;
    } isa;
} Decode;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>cpu.pc</code>初始值为<code>0x8000 0000</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>从调用<code>exec_once()</code>并开始执行<code>auipc</code>开始考虑</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>忽略trace和difftest相关的操作</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="exec_onces-cpupc">exec_once(&amp;s, cpu.pc);</h2>
<p>调用<code>exec_once(&amp;s, cpu.pc)</code>，当前<code>cpu.pc</code>值为<code>0x8000 0000</code></p>
<p>进入<code>exec_once()</code>后，更新<code>s</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">s-&gt;pc = 0x80000000;
s-&gt;snpc = 0x80000000;
</code></pre>
<p>调用<code>isa_exec_once(s)</code></p>
<h2 id="isa_exec_onces">isa_exec_once(s)</h2>
<p>利用<code>inst_fetch(&amp;s-&gt;snpc, 4)</code>更新<code>s</code>。<code>inst_fetch</code>返回<code>snpc</code>对应的指令地址（<code>uint32_t</code>类型）,并且更新<code>snpc</code>为下一条指令所在地址(<code>s-&gt;snpc += 4</code>, 即<code>0x8000 0004</code>)。<br>
更新后的<code>s</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">s-&gt;pc = 0x80000000;
s-&gt;snpc = 0x80000004;
s-&gt;isa.inst = 0x80000000;
</code></pre>
<p>之后执行<code>decode_exec(s)</code>并将其结果返回.</p>
<h2 id="decode_execs">decode_exec(s)</h2>
<p>更新<code>s-&gt;dnpc = s-&gt;snpc</code>, 此时<code>s</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">s-&gt;pc = 0x80000000;
s-&gt;snpc = 0x80000004;
s-&gt;dnpc = 0x80000004;
s-&gt;isa.inst = 0x80000000;
</code></pre>
<p>定义<strong>标签地址</strong>, 用于之后跳转:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">const void * __instpat_end = &amp;&amp;__instpat_end_;
</code></pre>
<p>指令匹配:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">INSTPAT("??????? ????? ????? ??? ????? 00101 11", auipc  , U, R(rd) = s-&gt;pc + imm);
INSTPAT("??????? ????? ????? 100 ????? 00000 11", lbu    , I, R(rd) = Mr(src1 + imm, 1));
INSTPAT("??????? ????? ????? 000 ????? 01000 11", sb     , S, Mw(src1 + imm, 1, src2));

INSTPAT("0000000 00001 00000 000 00000 11100 11", ebreak , N, NEMUTRAP(s-&gt;pc, R(10))); // R(10) is $a0
INSTPAT("??????? ????? ????? ??? ????? ????? ??", inv    , N, INV(s-&gt;pc));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="instpat-指令匹配宏">INSTPAT() 指令匹配宏</h3>
<p>宏展开后, 匹配成功第一条规则:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">do {
    uint64_t key, mask, shift;
    pattern_decode("??????? ????? ????? ??? ????? 00101 11",
        (sizeof("??????? ????? ????? ??? ????? 00101 11") - 1), &amp;key, &amp;mask, &amp;shift);
    if ((((uint64_t)((s)-&gt;isa.inst) &gt;&gt; shift) &amp; mask) == key) {
        {
            int rd = 0;
            word_t src1 = 0, src2 = 0, imm = 0;
            decode_operand(s, &amp;rd, &amp;src1, &amp;src2, &amp;imm, TYPE_U);
            (cpu.gpr[check_reg_idx(rd)]) = s-&gt;pc + imm ;
        };
        goto *(__instpat_end);
    }
    } while (0)
</code></pre>
<p>其中<code>(sizeof("??????? ????? ????? ??? ????? 00101 11") - 1) == 38</code></p>
<h3 id="pattern_decode-解码宏">pattern_decode() 解码宏</h3>
<p>进入<code>pattern_decode()</code>宏后, 定义临时变量<code>uint64_t __key = 0, __mask = 0, __shift = 0;</code>. 之后<code>pattern_decode()</code> 会利用辅助宏<code>macro(i)</code>.<br>
在<code>macro(i)</code>中:</p>
<ol>
<li>若<code>str[i]</code>是<code>'1'</code>, <code>__key</code>左移并且低位补1; 若不是, <code>__key</code>左移并且低位补0;</li>
<li>若<code>str[i]</code>是<code>'?'</code>, <code>__mask</code>左移并且低位补0;<br>
若不是, <code>__mask</code>左移并且低位补1</li>
<li>若<code>str[i]</code>是<code>'?'</code>, <code>__shift</code>加1, 否则立刻清0</li>
</ol>
<p>通过:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">#define macro2(i)  macro(i);   macro((i) + 1)
#define macro4(i)  macro2(i);  macro2((i) + 2)
#define macro8(i)  macro4(i);  macro4((i) + 4)
#define macro16(i) macro8(i);  macro8((i) + 8)
#define macro32(i) macro16(i); macro16((i) + 16)
#define macro64(i) macro32(i); macro32((i) + 32)
  macro64(0);
</code></pre>
<p>处理指令掩码中的38个字符.<br>
本例中, <code>__key</code>最终为<code>0010111</code>, <code>__mask</code>最终为<code>000...00(共25个0)1111111</code>, <code>__shift</code>最终为<code>0</code><br>
跳转到<code>finish</code>标签后执行:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">finish:
  *key = __key &gt;&gt; __shift;
  *mask = __mask &gt;&gt; __shift;
  *shift = __shift;
</code></pre>
<p>然后退出<code>pattern_decode()</code>宏, 进入<code>INSTPAT</code>宏的:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">if ((((uint64_t)INSTPAT_INST(s) &gt;&gt; shift) &amp; mask) == key) { \
INSTPAT_MATCH(s, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
goto *(__instpat_end); \
} \
</code></pre>
<p><code>(uint64_t)INSTPAT_INST(s)</code>即执行的指令<code>inst</code>. <code>inst</code>被右移<code>shift</code>位, 然后和<code>mask</code>按位与, 判断是否和<code>key</code>完全相等<br>
如果相等, 则执行:</p>
<pre><code class="language-C">INSTPAT_MATCH(s, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
goto *(__instpat_end); \
</code></pre>
<h3 id="isnt_match-执行指令宏">ISNT_MATCH() 执行指令宏</h3>
<p>在这个宏里, 会利用<code>decode_operand()</code>函数来译码出<code>rd</code>, <code>src</code>, <code>src2</code>, <code>imm</code>. 然后执行<code>__VA_ARGS__ ;</code>. <code>__VA_ARGS__</code>就是在<code>INSTPAT()</code>中传入的指令的具体操作. 对于<code>auipc</code>这条指令, <code>__VA_ARGS</code>就是<code>R(rd) = s-&gt;pc + imm</code>.</p>

</div>
